items.heading: Pupusas
details: Key ingredients: corn masa, cheese, refried beans, pork (chicharron)
Mix corn masa with water into a soft, pliable dough.
Flatten a ball of dough and fill with cheese, beans or chicharron.
Seal the filling inside and pat back into a thick disc.
Cook on a hot griddle until lightly charred on both sides.

items.heading: Curtido
details: Key ingredients: cabbage, carrot, onion, vinegar, oregano
Shred cabbage, carrot and onion finely.
Toss with vinegar, oregano and a pinch of salt.
Let the mixture sit to lightly pickle and soften.
Serve as a tangy topping alongside pupusas.
